transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, I'm here because for months now I’ve been trying to get people to understand what's going on. My husband’s family is quietly messing with our money and our good name. It happens in these little ways... like, I'll see little billing errors show up at my work, or someone at church will suddenly act funny toward me. People try to pull up records or paperwork to tell me it's just a mistake or a coincidence, but no matter what anyone pulls up, I know it ties back to them. I just need someone to actually listen to me about it.
Have you ever heard voices or sounds that other people couldn't hear?

No, I haven't experienced anything like that. I don't hear voices or anything that isn't really there. I just notice the things that are actually happening, like the billing issues and the way people act.
Over the past few months, have you been experiencing persistent feelings of sadness or a loss of interest in things you usually enjoy?

No, not really. I mean, I'm not sad. It's... well, it's frustrating, obviously, dealing with what his family is doing behind my back. But I haven't lost interest in my normal life or anything like that. I still do the things I usually enjoy. I just want them to stop messing with my life.
Do you have any ongoing medical conditions, or have you had any recent physical illnesses or head injuries?
No, nothing like that. I'm perfectly healthy. I haven't been sick, and I certainly haven't hit my head. My body is fine, it's just this situation with my husband's family that I'm dealing with.
Before this started with your husband's family, have you generally been a distrustful person or found it hard to trust people throughout your life?

No, not at all. I've never really had a problem trusting people before. I mean, I just go to work, do my job, and get along fine with everyone. I've always been pretty trusting, honestly. It's really just his family that I don't trust right now, but that's only because they've given me a very real reason not to.
